name: Contrast Checker
tagline: Whether two colours are far enough apart to read.
description:
Enter a foreground and a background as hex, or pick them, and read the WCAG 2 contrast ratio between them. The four thresholds are listed with their numbers and a plain pass or fail: 4.5 for body text at AA, 7 for AAA, 3 for large text, and 3 for interface targets such as borders, icons and focus rings.

The preview shows both a heading and a thirteen pixel paragraph in the pair, because a ratio that reads comfortably at nineteen pixels can be hard work at thirteen. Three-digit hex is accepted and normalised.

"Fix the foreground" searches outwards from the current colour, one per cent darker and one per cent lighter at a time, and stops at the first value that clears 4.5:1 — so the suggestion is the smallest change that passes rather than a jump to black.
releaseNotes: Added the interface target threshold and a repair that keeps the hue.
